Container.Name: squirrelcade
Container.Overview: Squirrelcade keeps track of a video game collection: every copy you own, completion per console from Wikipedia's lists, a wishlist that explains every point, Store Mode for your phone in a store (barcode scanning, even offline), selling a game (eBay and Mercari listings written for you), achievements from RetroAchievements, Xbox, PlayStation and Steam, each console's Top 100 and history, and your PC games from Playnite. It starts from your PriceCharting export (or a spreadsheet), and everything else is optional. Help > AI-assisted setup gives a prompt for your own AI to take you through the rest.

Config.Name: Web interface
Config.Description: The port Squirrelcade's pages are on.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: The database, settings, logs and Squirrelcade's own backups: back this folder up.

Config.Name: Imports
Config.Description: The watched folder: a PriceCharting export saved here updates your collection within 15 minutes.

Config.Name: Playnite backups
Config.Description: Optional, for the PC library: the folder Playnite saves its library backups to (Playnite > Settings > Backup), read-only. Then Settings > Features > PC library, folder /playnite.

Config.Name: Second backup folder
Config.Description: Optional: another disk or share where each of Squirrelcade's backups is copied too. Then Settings > Storage > Second backup folder, /backup-copies.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Your time zone, such as America/Chicago or Europe/London.
